tagline: How a zero-config Python library routes LLM calls, records every one in local SQLite, and turns accumulated telemetry into evidence-backed model recommendations.

pages.purpose: Introduce what somm is, the problem it solves, and the shape of the system: a local-first telemetry substrate with routing, evaluation, and intelligence layered on top — no hosted control plane, no commercial dependencies on the hot path.
